# Contributing to Widgetron

Thanks for helping out! Please read the whole guide before opening a pull request.

## Legal

- [Contributor License Agreement](https://example.org/cla) - all contributors
  must sign the CLA before we can merge a pull request.

## AI Guidance

Using AI tools to help write your PR is acceptable, but as the author you are
responsible for understanding every change. If AI tools helped you prepare the
PR, you must disclose this in the description of your PR. For example, adding
"Parts of this PR were drafted with help from an AI assistant." to the PR
description is sufficient.

Naming an AI tool as a co-author, co-signing commits with an AI tool, or adding
an `assisted-by`, `co-developed` or similar commit trailer is not allowed.

AI generated commit messages are not allowed.

When you answer review comments, do it without relying on AI tools. Reviewers
want to talk to you, not to a generator.

If you cannot explain why a change was made, the PR will be closed.
